  -- Result: Concluded that Ghost-Town Gold has the director who was born first.

- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Coordinated the search and analysis process.
  -- Observation: Monitored the progress of the search and ensured accurate data collection.
  -- Thought: Organized the comparison of birth dates to draw the final conclusion.
